stage: Before all new-source model calls; after inspecting available full texts
original_candidate: Seoul 2024 original -> December amendment; original PDF not recovered from housing board and March youth notices (only poster images).
used_pair: Seoul 2024-3494 December amendment -> 2025-1082 March amendment. This is a cross-year comparison, NOT a recovered 2024 original/revised pair.
selection: Purposive two-source-family sample. Not random, blind or externally preregistered. No replacement based on model predictions.
normalization: PyMuPDF get_text(sort=True), one page at a time, Unicode whitespace collapsed via split/join; no OCR or manual text correction.
extraction_warnings: Seoul PDFs emit MuPDF invalid-key warnings. Original bytes preserved; relevant body pages visually checked. No table-specific claims.
annotation: AI provisional references, independent human review 0. Labels created before new predictions; same agent saw development outputs and the source texts.
scope: 32 fixed hypothetical claims (16 each), provided in curated and top3 retrieval contexts. 64 inputs are not 64 independent policy events. Versions are rule-comparison tasks, not historical benefit entitlement.
routing_convention: Changed location-set criterion requires recheck even for still-inside/outside profiles; explicit pre-cutoff insurance cohort retains its cap and uses keep. New inter-program condition is not inferred from former silence.
evidence_scoring: Frozen evaluator uses one deterministic sufficient ID set. Auxiliary provenance.py scores union of cited current-source intervals, admitting equivalent overlapping chunks. Absent support sentinel is never a model input. Not-established support is context coverage, not a proof of document-wide absence.
retrieval: All 34 PDF pages including forms. Fixed method before full-source reading. Fit version-local TF-IDF; no reference use.
